title: GuidanceResponse
description: Resolved guidance for a finding. Derived from the policy doctrine document in directives via paired_policy_ref and Directives Adapter (DirectiveRepository.readPolicyDoctrine). Guidance_only path per gate AA-02 — never used for evaluation or FSM transitions.

paired_policy_ref.description: Reference resolving to the policy doctrine document in directives (e.g. 'sc101_parameterized_queries').

reasoning.description: Chain of reasoning explaining why this guidance applies to the finding. Derived from the policy's rationale field.

examples: Replace string interpolation with parameterized query
Add structured error handling with specific exception types

remediation_steps.description: Ordered list of concrete steps to remediate the finding.
examples: Import the database parameterized query API
Replace f-string query construction with parameter placeholders
Bind parameters via the driver's parameter binding mechanism
Add integration test verifying no SQL injection vector

domain_examples.description: Illustrative examples from the policy doctrine showing compliant and non-compliant patterns.

snippet.description: Code or content snippet illustrating the pattern.

language.description: Programming language or content format of the snippet.

vocabulary.description: Definitions of domain-specific terms used in the guidance.

definition.description: Clear definition of the term in context.

examples.reasoning: The finding detected string interpolation in a SQL query construction, which creates a SQL injection vector. The paired policy mandates parameterized queries for all database interactions.
examples.remediation_strategy: Replace string interpolation with parameterized query
remediation_steps: Import the database parameterized query API
Replace f-string query construction with parameter placeholders
Bind parameters via the driver's parameter binding mechanism
Add integration test verifying no SQL injection vector

domain_examples.label: non_compliant
domain_examples.snippet: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='{username}'"

domain_examples.label: compliant
domain_examples.snippet:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name=?"
db.execute(query, (username,))

vocabulary.definition: A database query where user-supplied values are passed as separate parameters rather than interpolated into the query string, preventing SQL injection.
